evidence: Each viral GENE ID (var_name) is analysed as a separate "virus". Repro: `python analysis/audit_2026-10/repro_B/r_hr1.py <dir>` with one virus (vA) split over genes vA_g1 (12 positive cells) and vA_g2 (12 other cells), detection_threshold=1 -> hostresponse_status.tsv has two rows 'vA_g1','vA_g2' (n_positive=12 each); the other gene's 12 positive cells are counted as NEGATIVES. A virus with many ORFs is never pooled (detection.py groups by virus_key; hostresponse does not), so per-gene positives often fall below MIN_VIRUS_CELLS=10 and the virus is silently skipped, and negatives are contaminated by cells positive for the same virus via another gene. Docs describe 'per-virus' models.
proposed_fix: Group viral_vars by virus_key via the identity table (as detection.group_genes) and sum counts per virus before _virus_presence_label; name outputs by virus.

evidence: qc_hist savefig runs before os.makedirs(plots). plots/ is only created by detection.histogram when config.visual AND >=1 virus detected. Repro: `python analysis/audit_2026-10/repro_B/r_umap2.py` (no plots dir, found_genes={}) -> FileNotFoundError .../plots/qc_hist_total_counts.png. So --umap on a negative sample (exactly the path the 'no viral load' UMAP branch exists for) or with --no-visual crashes. No other code creates plots/ (grep).
proposed_fix: os.makedirs(f"{config.output}/plots", exist_ok=True) at top of umap() (or in detection.main).

evidence: 'Infected' = viral_umi_per_cell > 0 on the selected-method matrix, which holds fractional EM/multimap weights. Repro r_det1.py: X=[[1e-9,0,500],[0,0,500]] -> infected_cells=1 while viral_molecules_total_est=0; any cell with a sliver of an EM allocation (e.g. 0.03 of a sibling-shared molecule) counts as an infected cell, enters per_cell_viral.tsv, and inflates pct_infected*, infected_called and the Fisher enrichment table. Magnitude on real EM output not measured (no real data run).
proposed_fix: Define infected on a molecule-level floor (e.g. >= 1 molecule, or >= a declared min allocation) and expose it as a parameter; use the same definition in enrichment/umap/hostresponse.

evidence: Detection gate (default detection_threshold=1) is applied to the virus total summed over ALL barcodes incl. empty droplets (found_genes is computed in preprocessing() before cell calling). Repro: detect_genes(["h1","v1"], [[0,1],[0,0]], ["v1"]) -> {'v1': 1}: one UMI in one barcode = 'detected'; summary.txt then prints 'Found viral Gene IDs', 'Total amount of viral load found', 'Official name of viral load detected'. Ambient RNA / barcode swapping / index hopping all produce 1-UMI calls. Mitigation exists (docs call it 'candidate', infected_called is reported, evidence ladder) but infected_called may be 0 for a 'detected' row and the summary wording is not conditioned.
proposed_fix: Evaluate the gate on called cells (or require >=N cells / >=2 UMIs distinct UMI+barcode); reword summary.txt as 'candidate'; flag rows with infected_called==0.

evidence: summary.txt headline '{infected_cells}/{total_cells} cells infected ({pct_infected}%)' and 'Cells with viral reads: x/n_cells' use the ALL-barcode denominator, while docs/faq.md and code comments state pct_infected_called is the primary. r_det1.py compute_stats: pct_infected=66.67 vs pct_infected_called=100 for the same data; on a raw 6M-barcode matrix the headline is a meaningless tiny %.
proposed_fix: Print called-cell numbers first in summary.txt.

evidence: Default index_viruses=() is passed to below_gate_counts, which calls .items(). Repro r_det1.py: below_gate_counts(a,None,(),{}) -> AttributeError 'tuple' object has no attribute 'items'. build_sensitivity_records accepts any iterable of names but outputs requires a dict {virus: genes}: inconsistent contract (main passes a dict, so no live crash).
proposed_fix: Type/validate index_viruses as Mapping or default to {}.

evidence: Repro r_det1.py: positive_control_expected_molecules=0 -> ZeroDivisionError; =-5 -> status 'failed' with message 'planted at -5 molecules but 5 were recovered' (misleading). Not checked whether RunConfig validates expected>0.
proposed_fix: Validate expected > 0 up front with a configuration error.

evidence: Standalone API: matrix with NaN -> found == {} (NaN sum compares False, silent drop); duplicate var_names -> pos dict keeps last, returns {} for [[5,0],[0,0]] with names ['v1','v1'] (r_det1.py). preprocessing() guards duplicates, but detect_genes is documented 'pure and importable'.
proposed_fix: np.isfinite check and uniqueness assert in detect_genes.

evidence: Zero-cell adata -> ValueError 'cannot convert float NaN to integer' (r_det1.py). Docstring says 'UMI count > 10' but code uses >= se_threshold. title uses int(max) truncating fractional counts. Mutates caller adata (var_names_make_unique, obs columns).
proposed_fix: Guard n_obs==0; fix docstring; avoid mutating input.

evidence: host_cells sets are suffix-stripped ('-1' removed) but compared with raw adata.obs_names via np.isin. r_det1.py: obs AAA,CCC,GGG vs comparable {'AAA-1',...} -> infected_comparable=0, n_comparable_cells=3, pct_infected_comparable=0.0 (a silent zero, not 'unavailable'). r_cc1.py confirms external_host_cells returns {'AAA','CCC'} from a '-1' list. Real impact only if obs_names carry a suffix (kb normally does not).
proposed_fix: Normalise both sides with _strip_suffix, and raise if intersection with obs_names is empty.

evidence: Style rule 'no manual string concatenation for paths': open(f"{config.output}/summary.txt") and open(f"{config.output}log/found_genes.txt") rely on a trailing separator (RunConfig.from_yaml normalises; RunConfig(output='x') does not). Not run-reproduced.
proposed_fix: os.path.join / Path.

evidence: Repro r_hr2.py: _bh_fdr([0.01,0.02,nan]) -> [nan nan nan]; a single NaN p (NaN in x_genes) turns the whole fdr column NaN so n_differential_fdr05 reports 0 with no warning (p NaN for that gene confirmed via _genome_wide_differential).
proposed_fix: Compute BH over finite p only; raise/warn on NaN input.

evidence: t-test df = n-2 although k covariates (log depth, %mito) are residualised: r_hr2.py n=14: p=0.783 vs OLS (statsmodels) 0.792; n=100: 2.1e-13 vs 2.8e-13 (anti-conservative, negligible at large n). Zero-variance gene gets p=1 (counted in BH family, conservative) and direction 'up' (r>=0 tie). No min-n guard (n=3 returns table). Calibration under simulated cell-level null was fine: r_hr3.py frac p<0.05 = 0.046 (pure null), 0.033 (depth-confounded null), 0 genes at FDR<0.05.
proposed_fix: df = n-2-k; direction NaN when std==0; guard n<=k+3.

evidence: Docstring: 'keeping prevalence identical ... same number of positives'. r_hr2.py: counts=[3,3,1,0,0,0], depth=[3000,3000,1000,5000,5000,5000], thr=3 -> n_pos expected 2, got 3 (ties at the cutoff are all kept).
proposed_fix: Break ties deterministically (argsort[:n_pos]) or document.

evidence: E-value formula applied to an odds ratio as if it were a risk ratio regardless of outcome prevalence. In depth_match mode prevalence is 50% by construction, where the sqrt(OR) conversion applies (secondary source via web search: VanderWeele & Ding 2017 rule, rare <15%, common 15-85%; primary paper NOT verified). No CI-bound E-value. 'robust' (>=3.0)/'moderate' (>=1.5) labels are arbitrary and say nothing about measured confounders. Formula arithmetic checked (r_hr2.py: OR=2 -> 3.414).
proposed_fix: Use sqrt(OR) when prevalence >15%; report E-value for the CI limit; rename flags or document as heuristic.

evidence: API default detection_threshold=10 with comment '>=10 EBV UMI is the validated positive-call threshold'; CLI passes cfg.detection_threshold (default 1) -> per-cell positive label is a single UMI (ambient/hopping-prone) through the CLI. Same name, different meaning (sample gate vs per-cell label).
proposed_fix: Separate parameter (--hostresponse-min-umi) with default 10 or document.

evidence: Output column observed_group_auc is the AUC_STATISTIC 'mean_over_seeds_of_fold_mean_test_auc', not the group-equal AUC (which is the separate cv_group_equal_auc). The name suggests a per-group AUC; permutation p (empirical_p_auc) is for the fold-mean statistic.
proposed_fix: Rename to observed_cv_auc.

evidence: Known cell-level inference. Additionally the BH family is the HVG set when use_hvg=True (default): X_stab_v is HVG-only, though the module docstring says 'genome-wide'. p_value/fdr columns carry no 'cell-level, donor-unadjusted' caveat in the CSV itself (only in manifest descriptive_inference_unit).
proposed_fix: Add column/header note; state family in outputs.

evidence: shared_barcodes = intersection of virus and host barcodes; unmatched barcodes dropped silently unless <20 shared (log only). For two-step runs the viral matrix holds only barcodes with non-host reads (compute_stats docstring), so zero-viral cells absent from it are never negatives -> selection of negatives. Not verified on real data.
proposed_fix: Reindex virus matrix to host cells (zero-fill) and log the dropped fraction.

evidence: 'except Exception: pass' silently drops failed iterations (valid_iters is the denominator, so probabilities stay finite but failures are invisible). Selection threshold stab_min_prob=0.6 with fixed C=1.0 is not tied to Meinshausen-Buhlmann error control (no E[V] bound); 'stable' is descriptive only.
proposed_fix: Count/log failed iterations; document that 'stable' carries no FWER guarantee.

evidence: Gini is computed only over positions that have >=1 read-start, so total concentration scores 0 (= 'even'). Repro: `python analysis/audit_2026-10/repro_B/r_evid.py` -> gini([100])=0.0, gini([50,50])=0.0, gini([1,99])=0.49. A single-position pile-up (PCR/EVE hotspot) reads as the most even distribution in alignment_qc column read_start_gini (flags use max_50bp_window_fraction, so only the column misleads).
proposed_fix: Include zero-start positions over reference length, or drop/rename the column.

evidence: UMAP defines virus_positive as count >= 1 on adata.raw.X / layers['counts'] / X (that order), detection uses > 0 on the selected-method adata.X; the two can disagree (fractional EM weights < 1; a 'counts' layer different from X). Code-reading only.
proposed_fix: Reuse detection's matrix/definition (resolve_count_matrix).

evidence: When QC removes every cell the function print()s and returns, exit status 0, no plots (r_umap.py: 'all-filtered return: None'). Also min_counts=1000 is applied to adata.X, which for a viral-only (two-step) matrix would remove all cells.
proposed_fix: raise or log.error and fail the rule.

evidence: kNN on 2-D UMAP coordinates (a visualisation) with a Python loop of n_permutations x n_viral cells; k>n raises ValueError (r_umap.py: k=10, n=8). Clustering p<0.05 text 'significant clustering' is unadjusted for cell type/depth confounding. UMAP reproducibility verified: two runs give identical html modulo plotly uuids (random_state=0).
proposed_fix: Use the PCA kNN graph; cap k at n-1; vectorise.

evidence: Partial barcode overlap is silent (only zero overlap warns); duplicate labels resolved by keep='first'; unlabeled cells dropped; Fisher test unadjusted for library size / depth (cell types with more UMIs detect more ambient viral UMIs); BH family = all virus x cell-type tests (acceptable). Code-reading only.
proposed_fix: Log overlap fraction; warn on conflicting duplicates; consider depth-stratified test.

evidence: A -w list with Cell Ranger '-1' suffixes: r_chem.py -> rate 0.0 and message 'does not belong to this library', a misdiagnosis (plain list gives 1.0).
proposed_fix: Strip suffix in match_rates or say so in the message.

evidence: Docstring: exact LOD is '~1.3-2x lower' than linear. r_sens1.py: T=2 1.26x, T=10 1.91x, T=50 2.41x (exact lambda 62.2 vs 149.8). Capture DP verified against Monte Carlo (r_sens1.py: 0.7079 vs 0.7096 at d=0.05 etc.) - clean.
proposed_fix: Fix wording.

evidence: Molecule verdict compares max AS over reads on the virus side against max AS over reads on the host side, taken independently across reads of the same molecule (different reads/lengths can supply the two maxima). Code-reading only.
proposed_fix: Decide per read, then aggregate per molecule.

evidence: Output slug re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]+','_') can collide for two selectors ('X-1' vs 'X 1'), silently overwriting. Code-reading only.
proposed_fix: Detect collisions like hostresponse does.

evidence: Picks forward vs reverse when both ratios >= tau with no margin (e.g. 0.81 vs 0.80); pilot uses the first 1M reads only (lane/tile bias). Code-reading only.
proposed_fix: Require a margin or fall back to unstranded.

evidence: Flags have no minimum-read guard: one read -> max_50bp_window_fraction=1.0 -> both 'coverage_hotspot' and 'eve_or_integration_like_hotspot' = flagged (r_evid.py). With few reads every virus looks EVE-like/hotspot, so flags are tautological at low depth (labelled diagnostic_only). Fixed 50-bp grid also splits a hotspot straddling a boundary.
proposed_fix: Report not_assessed below N reads (e.g. <20); use sliding window.

evidence: Reads compatible with 2 genes of the SAME target virus (overlapping ORFs) are labelled virus_virus_ambiguous / candidate_virus_ambiguous with weight 1.0 (r_evid.py: _target_assignment([1,2],{1,2},{1,2},..) -> ('virus_virus_ambiguous',1.0,...)). interpretation_flags then counts them as non-unique and raises 'sibling_or_host_ambiguity' (>=25%) though no sibling/host is involved.
proposed_fix: Classify within-target multi-gene ECs as unique_target (same virus).

evidence: Blank viral_minus_host_bitscore ('' or missing, e.g. no hit) is coerced to 0 and counted as host-preferred: r_evid.py blast=[{'viral_minus_host_bitscore':''}] -> host_homology flagged, metric 1.0 (the later no_hits override applies only when diagnostic_class exists).
proposed_fix: Treat missing as not assessed.
